Introduction to Semiconductor Manufacturing ## [繁體中文](zh-TW/README.md) ｜ [English](en/README.md) ｜ [日本語](ja/README.md) ｜ [한국어](ko/README.md) [![License: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-CC%20BY--NC--SA%204.0-lightgrey.svg)](LICENSE) ![Chapters](https://img.shields.io/badge/chapters-25-blue.svg) ![Languages](https://img.shields.io/badge/languages-zh--TW%20%7C%20en%20%7C%20ja%20%7C%20ko-red.svg) [![Contributions welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/contributions-welcome-brightgreen.svg)](CONTRIBUTING.md)
An open, beginner-friendly book that follows one silicon wafer from sand, through the fab, test and packaging, until it becomes a chip. It skips heavy physics and focuses on process flow, terminology and know-how from the fab floor, with term boxes and know-how boxes in every chapter. CCBaga

A native macOS toolkit for a cleaner workspace and an environment you can verify.

Claude cleanup · Browser fingerprints · System settings · Network setup

Features · Installation · Updates · Quick start · Architecture · Development · Contributing

![CCBaga: native control, observable environments](docs/readme-hero.png) CCBaga brings local maintenance and environment setup into one focused desktop workflow. Inspect Claude data before removing it, rotate your companion browser's fingerprint and restart it, align system settings with a selected region, and compare real browser readings with the machine and network exit. Two applications work together: **CCBaga-A** owns native operations; **CCBaga-B** runs an isolated Fingerprint Chromium profile. Browser measurements return to the cleaner through a local session. Changing a setting and verifying its effect are separate steps. ## Features
Local Claude cleanup

Review caches, account traces, sessions, configuration remnants and existing backups. Select exactly what to remove.		 Fingerprint & restart

Generate a fresh seed, apply the selected region's language and timezone, then restart the companion browser.		 Real environment checks

Compare browser and machine readings with the actual network exit. Passing measured checks produces a green page and a large checkmark.
Native system settings

Apply timezone, preferred language and region settings. Open macOS controls for location and permissions.		 SSH network setup

Provide a VPS address, three key files and a residential SOCKS5 exit. Receive a subscription after server self-checks pass.		 Claude Code CLI tools

Detect the installation method and version. Uninstall or reinstall through native, npm or Homebrew workflows.
**One region selector. Four everyday actions.** Easy setup puts browser cache cleanup, fingerprint rotation, timezone/language reset and Claude cleanup on the same page. The sidebar keeps advanced controls in Network, Claude cleanup, Browser and Computer. The interface supports **English and Chinese**, with shared YAML catalogs. Switching the interface language does not change the computer or browser language. ## Installation **Platform:** macOS 12 or later, Apple Silicon. Intel, Windows and Linux application builds are not currently supported. Download the signed installer from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/liseami/CCBaga/releases/latest). The distribution package is named `CCBaga--macos-arm64.dmg`. It contains both applications: | Application | Installed bundle | Role | | --- | --- | --- | | CCBaga-A | `CCBaga-A.app` | Cleanup, system settings, SSH tasks and verification | | CCBaga-B | `CCBaga-B.app` | Companion browser with a dedicated profile | Download **one DMG**; it contains both applications. There is no separate browser download. The installer uses the same pixel-art style as this README. 1. Open the release disk image and drag **both applications** into Applications. 2. Launch CCBaga-A. It starts the companion browser automatically. 3. Choose English at the bottom of the sidebar if needed. Public release packages must pass Developer ID signing, Apple notarization, ticket stapling and Gatekeeper assessment. See the [release procedure](docs/releasing.md) for the exact checks. macOS may still display its normal first-launch confirmation and ask for permissions when you use privileged features. Source builds are available through the [development guide](#development). Every successful push to `release` produces a new version, tag and notarized installer. ## Updates Use **Check for updates** at the bottom of CCBaga-A’s sidebar. Startup checks quietly; installation only starts when you choose **Update and restart**. Downloads show actual progress and are verified against the embedded public key, including the signed version, before installation. Failed downloads can be retried; a failed restart does not download the update again. **Upgrading from v0.2.7 or v0.2.8:** replace both apps from the latest DMG once to correct the companion browser identity. In-app updates replace **CCBaga-A**. To update **both A and B**, download the latest DMG and drag both apps into Applications. No GitHub token or signing private key is included in either app. ## Quick start ### Everyday setup Open **Easy setup**, select a country or region, then choose an action. Browser fingerprint rotation closes and restarts CCBaga-B, so save unfinished browser work first. Selecting a region changes language, timezone and regional settings; it does **not** change your public IP. ### Claude cleanup Open **Claude cleanup** to scan and review local data. Use cache-only cleanup for regenerable files, login reset for account traces, or select a broader scope explicitly. A folder can also be dropped into the app for a scoped scan. If Claude is running, the confirmation flow can stop all recognized Claude processes and rescan. The latest scan must be reviewed before deletion. CLI uninstall and reinstall are separate operations and preserve settings, skills, sessions and project files. > [!WARNING] > Confirmed cleanup permanently deletes the selected files, including selected existing backups. It does not use Trash, create recovery copies or provide undo. Stopping Claude processes can interrupt unsaved work. ### Browser verification Open **Browser** or the companion browser's local test page to measure the actual environment. Checks cover the network exit, country, timezone, language, platform, CPU count, engine version and location settings. The success page appears only when the measured checks match, the report reaches the cleaner and no measurement error remains. **DNS and WebRTC leak checks are not independently verified.** A green result describes the measured checks, not a guarantee of anonymity or account acceptance. ### Network setup The optional network workflow expects: | Input | Requirement | | --- | --- | | VPS | Public IP or hostname; Debian 12/13; SSH as `root` on port `22` | | SSH keys | A matching `.pem`, `.ppk` and `.pub` bundle; an unencrypted PEM private key | | Residential exit | SOCKS5 host, port, username and password | | Expected exit IP | Required when the SOCKS5 host is a domain | For DMIT, choose **Generate SSH Key after order**, download and extract the key bundle, then select or drop all three files. Key files identify you; the VPS address identifies the server. Password and SSH Agent authentication are not supported. Check the SSH connection, review the server changes, then run setup. The script updates the Debian system, configures Xray/Reality, SSH and the firewall, and verifies the SOCKS5 exit before returning a subscription. It blocks forwarded UDP and retains a Stripe direct-route exception. > [!IMPORTANT] > Import the subscription into a compatible client, enable **TUN mode**, and leave **system proxy disabled**. Leave CCBaga-B's explicit proxy empty to follow TUN. The subscription uses HTTP and contains connection credentials; keep its URL private. Verify the client-side exit after importing it. Provider buttons link to [DMIT](https://www.dmit.io/aff.php?aff=28800) and [Webshare](https://www.webshare.io/?referral_code=qlm1mt9xibc9). These URLs contain affiliate/referral codes. Network setup is optional; local cleanup does not require a VPS or a proxy subscription. ## Architecture ![Pixel architecture map: native core, companion browser and explicit SSH](docs/architecture.svg) The UI owns inputs and presentation. Rust owns validation, task locks, process identity checks and execution. Small Objective-C bridges call platform APIs. The browser test page has no Tauri command access; it exchanges context and measurements through a random-token loopback session. | Layer | Technology | Responsibility | | --- | --- | --- | | Desktop host | Rust · Tauri 2 | Native commands, transactions, progress and lifecycle | | Interface | React 19 · TypeScript · Cromma UI | Forms, previews and execution results | | Platform bridges | AppKit · Security · CoreLocation | macOS permissions and system integration | | Companion browser | Fingerprint Chromium | Dedicated profile and real browser measurements | | Network setup | OpenSSH · Bash · Xray | Explicit remote setup and server self-checks | | Localization | YAML · Vite | Build-time English/Chinese catalogs |
Repository map ```text assets/ Compressed brand logos and pixel-art DMG background src/ Desktop UI, browser test page and localization src-tauri/src/ Rust commands and transaction boundaries src-tauri/native/ Small macOS API bridges browser-runtime/ Engine metadata, launcher, entitlements and licenses scripts/ Icons, signing, packaging and setup scripts docs/ README artwork and release procedure vendor/cromma-ui/ Vendored interface components ``` The large browser application and archive are generated/runtime inputs, excluded from Git. `CLAUDE.md` files map module boundaries; source headers describe inputs, outputs and responsibilities.
## Development ### Prerequisites Use an Apple Silicon Mac with Xcode Command Line Tools, stable Rust and Bun. Follow [Tauri's macOS prerequisites](https://v2.tauri.app/start/prerequisites/#macos) for the native toolchain. The browser engine is an external build input. `python3 scripts/fetch-browser.py` downloads the pinned macOS arm64 **Fingerprint Chromium 148.0.7778.215** engine from the [upstream project](https://github.com/adryfish/fingerprint-chromium), verifies its SHA-256 and preserves its bundle structure and notices. Browser runtime binaries are not included in the source repository. From your checkout: ```sh bun install --frozen-lockfile python3 scripts/fetch-browser.py sh scripts/make-icons.sh sh scripts/package-browser.sh bun run tauri dev ``` Local builds use ad-hoc signing by default, so another developer does not need the maintainer's certificate. They are not public distribution builds. See [Tauri's signing documentation](https://v2.tauri.app/distribute/sign/macos/) and the [release procedure](docs/releasing.md) for Developer ID signing and notarization. ### Automated releases Push to `release` to run the complete macOS pipeline: frontend and native tests, pinned engine verification, Developer ID signing, Apple notarization and offline ticket stapling. A successful run creates an increasing `v..` tag and uploads the dual-app DMG, signed A update archive, public `latest.json` and SHA-256 manifest. Public repositories also receive GitHub build provenance attestations. Rust dependency caching reduces repeat compilation. Apple and updater signing credentials stay in GitHub Secrets and a disposable runner keychain. See [release setup](docs/releasing.md#github-actions). ### Build ```sh MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=12.0 \ bun run tauri build --bundles app --features custom-protocol ``` The cleaner bundle is written to `src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/CCBaga-A.app`. The companion bundle remains at `browser-runtime/Browser.app` until copied to Applications as `CCBaga-B.app`. Release builds require `custom-protocol` to load the embedded UI. A release compilation without it fails explicitly, preventing an installed app from depending on the development server. ### Checks ```sh bun run build bun test MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=12.0 \ cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml python3 scripts/test-sign-browser.py bash -n scripts/setup-vps.sh ``` Automated tests exercise disposable fixtures and local test servers. They do not deploy a real VPS, delete your Claude account data or perform administrator-authorized system changes. Real SSH connectivity, client-side TUN routing and permission-dependent operations require validation in the target environment. ## Data & permissions - **Cleanup is local.** It targets recognized Claude data; project source, skills, plugins, hooks, commands and MCP settings are preserved. Cloud-side account records are outside its scope. - **Secrets stay out of UI logs.** SSH private-key contents remain in native code. A temporary PEM copy has `0600` permissions and is removed when the transaction ends. Keychain cleanup reads item attributes, not password contents. - **Network checks make real requests.** Exit detection uses `ipwho.is` with `ipapi.co` as a fallback on the same route. IP location is a service estimate. - **Remote changes are explicit.** Only the VPS you provide is contacted for SSH setup. Server credentials remain in the server configuration required to run its services. - **Permissions are feature-specific.** Timezone changes require macOS administrator authorization. Keychain access follows system prompts. Location controls may require Accessibility permission or a manual action in System Settings. Custom `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` locations are not automatically included in the default cleanup scan. The app reports this limitation rather than silently claiming they were cleaned. ## Contributing Start with [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). # Awesome Embodied Agents

A curated reading list on **foundation-model-driven embodied agents**: reasoning, planning, tool use, spatial memory, execution feedback, and self-improvement.

**Focus: papers first published from September 2026 onward.** Earlier papers are kept in a collapsed background-reading section. VLA and world-model work is included when it contributes to an agent system or provides a meaningful comparison.

[Read the paper collection](https://hongboduan.github.io/awesome-embodied-agents/) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Suggest a paper](https://github.com/hongboduan/awesome-embodied-agents/issues) · [RSS](https://hongboduan.github.io/awesome-embodied-agents/feed.xml)

## Reading map

| Question | Research direction |
| --- | --- |
| How does a model turn a goal into an executable plan? | Reasoning, planning, code and tools |
| How does an agent retain and use observations? | Spatial state, memory and retrieval |
| How does execution adapt to failures? | Monitoring, feedback and recovery |
| What improves through interaction? | In-context learning and self-improvement |
| How do agents work with learned policies? | Agent–VLA/WAM interfaces |
| What does an experiment actually demonstrate? | Benchmarks, protocols and real-robot evidence |

The website includes source-linked reading notes, original paper figures, method comparison, and landscape/portrait cards for reading and sharing. Publication dates refer to the first arXiv submission; revisions are tracked separately.

## Reading labels

- **Source-checked:** checked against an original abstract or author source; not necessarily a full-paper review.
- **Full review:** a paper-specific reading with evidence and limitations.
- **AI draft:** a machine-assisted reading with page-linked excerpts; still requires editorial verification.
- **Discovery candidate:** automatically discovered metadata; relevance and claims await review.

Automatically extracted illustrations retain their PDF source and page. A page preview is labeled as such. Results from different evaluation protocols are not presented as a common leaderboard.

items.description: 麦麦预算餐：基于麦当劳 MCP 的真实核价、预算比较与餐品替换 Skill
items.readme:
# 麦麦预算餐

“预算30元，想吃汉堡和喝的，帮我选几种。”

![30元预算的真实核价快照](assets/result-preview.svg)

麦麦预算餐是基于麦当劳中国 MCP 的点餐决策 Skill：查询所选门店菜单和可用优惠，将少量候选交给官方工具核价，给出预算内的餐单、剩余预算与优惠条件。适合想控制单餐预算、又不想反复切换菜单和优惠券页面的单人到店取餐用户。

## 能做什么

- 保留你想吃的餐品，比较最多三份不同搭配。
- 显示整单应付总额、预算余量、餐品数量与优惠条件。
- 换饮料或加小食后重新核价。
- 无预算内方案时明确列出超额，不擅自增加预算。
- 检查必选数量、不要的餐品和可替代的餐品类别，例如“至少两个汉堡”“饮料不要可乐”。
- 使用批量入口一次处理最多三份已准备的候选；官方核价返回自动进入预算比较，减少手工抄价格。

可以这样问：

| 需求 | 输出重点 |
|---|---|
| “30元，汉堡和饮料” | 最低价、另两份不同搭配、剩余预算 |
| “不要可乐，汉堡保留” | 检查排除项，替换后对完整餐单重新核价 |
| “25元，两个汉堡” | 实际汉堡份数达到2，超预算时明确说明 |
| “有券就比较，没有券也行” | 先核实门店可用券；没有券时正常比较 |

本版仅支持同一门店、单人到店取餐，停在餐单建议阶段。没有自动下单功能。

## 安装与使用

需要支持远程 MCP 的 AI 客户端，如 WorkBuddy、Cherry Studio 或 Cursor。客户端运行 Skill 与用它开发项目是两回事；使用本项目不要求 WorkBuddy。配套脚本需要 Python 3.10及以上，无第三方依赖。原生工具可正常调用时，脚本可选；遇到本次 WorkBuddy 核价兼容性问题时，使用直连脚本完成核价。

1. 从 [麦当劳 MCP 平台](https://open.mcd.cn/mcp) 登录并激活自己的 Token。
2. 按 [官方 MCP 指南](https://github.com/M-China/mcd-mcp-server#2-快速开始) 接入 `https://mcp.mcd.cn`，使用 Streamable HTTP。
3. 下载本仓库。客户端支持 Skill 导入时，导入完整的 `skills/mcd-budget-meal` 文件夹；否则打开仓库目录，要求 AI 读取 `skills/mcd-budget-meal/SKILL.md`，按其中流程处理本次请求。只粘贴正文也可使用对话流程，配套脚本需能访问本地文件。
4. 输入预算、门店、喜欢或不想要的餐品。AI 通过你的 MCP 连接器查询并核价，然后展示餐单。

**WorkBuddy用户的简便安装**：下载仓库 ZIP并解压，在仓库目录的 PowerShell 中运行 `./install.ps1`，然后新开 WorkBuddy 会话。脚本只复制技能文件，已有技能会先备份；它不安装软件、不读取 Token、不修改连接器。也可以把下面这句话发给自己的 WorkBuddy：

```text
请安装技能 https://github.com/Sam-Hui-dot/mcd-budget-meal 。
将 skills/mcd-budget-meal 整个文件夹放入用户技能目录，保留 scripts 和 references。
安装后告诉我实际目录，并提示我新开会话。已有麦当劳连接器，不要重配。
```

完整点击顺序和常见问题见 [快速开始](docs/quick-start.md)。

WorkBuddy 若报告 `/items: must be array`，Skill会改用项目内的官方 MCP直连路径。无需反复修改连接器或重新申请 Token，具体操作见[直连核价说明](skills/mcd-budget-meal/references/workbuddy-compatibility.md)。

公开配置示例在 [mcp-config.example.json](mcp-config.example.json)，只含 `${MCD_MCP_TOKEN}` 占位符。环境变量展开方式取决于客户端；若不支持，在客户端自己的私有连接器配置中填入 Token，不修改公开示例、不把 Token 发到聊天里。

首次使用可输入：

```text
请读取 skills/mcd-budget-meal/SKILL.md，使用已启用的麦当劳 MCP。
预算30元，一个人，现在到店取餐，想吃一个汉堡和一杯饮料。
先让我选门店，再比较最多三份真实核价的餐单。不下单。
```

然后可以追问：

```text
保留汉堡，把饮料换成菜单里可选的另一种，预算还是30元，请重新核价。
```

## 离线示例

想先看比较格式，可以运行：

```powershell
python skills/mcd-budget-meal/scripts/compare_meals.py examples/demo-quotes.json
```

**下面全部是模拟餐品与价格，不是实时菜单，也不是真实 MCP 调用记录。**

| 示例方案 | 内容 | 示例金额 | 相对30元预算 |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| 基础搭配 | 示例汉堡＋示例茶饮 | ¥23.00 | 剩余 ¥7.00 |
| 加小食搭配 | 示例汉堡＋示例小份薯条＋示例茶饮 | ¥28.50 | 剩余 ¥1.50 |
| 增加一份小食 | 在加小食搭配上增加示例小食 | ¥32.50 | 超出 ¥2.50 |

比较脚本接收 AI 整理的核价 JSON，不持有凭证、不调用网络。它检查金额单位、必选编码、门店一致性和时间，按整单应付金额排序并合并相同餐单。详见 [本地数据格式](skills/mcd-budget-meal/references/quote-format.md)。

真实数据可以保存在被 Git 忽略的 `private/live-quotes.json`，再运行：

```powershell
python skills/mcd-budget-meal/scripts/compare_meals.py private/live-quotes.json --format json
```

## MCP 流程

```text
预算与口味 → 选定门店 → 查菜单、门店可用券 → 核对套餐选项
          → 构造少量候选 → 官方整单核价 → 预算比较 → 餐单建议
```

主要工具：`query-nearby-stores`、`query-meals`、`query-store-coupons`、`query-meal-detail`、`calculate-price`。具体职责和接入状态见 [MCP_INTEGRATION.md](MCP_INTEGRATION.md)。

## 批量核价与自动比较

AI先查询当前真实菜单、套餐详情和券，再将完整候选写入 `private/meal-plan.json`。用户不需要手写编码或价格。在仓库目录运行：

```powershell
python skills/mcd-budget-meal/scripts/quote_meals.py private/meal-plan.json --use-workbuddy-config --records-dir private/run-001
```

脚本检查餐单组成与请求是否一致，读取当前官方工具定义确认金额单位，然后顺序核价最多三份候选。成功报价自动换算为整数分、检查偏好并生成比较表。第一次失败后停止剩余请求，不自动重试；已有有效结果仍可查看。详细格式见[餐单计划说明](skills/mcd-budget-meal/references/meal-plan.md)。

想先了解计划结构，可以做本地检查（不联网、不读取凭证）：

```powershell
python skills/mcd-budget-meal/scripts/quote_meals.py examples/plan-template.json --check-plan
```

这个模板全部使用虚构编码，标为 `demo`，脚本禁止将它发到官方服务。原始调用记录只可写入本项目 `private/`，公开展示请使用经过人工脱敏的摘要。

## 当前状态与边界

2026年10月11日在深圳南科大餐厅完成真实菜单、可用券和套餐详情查询，三份官方核价分别为 ¥14.90、¥22.90、¥26.90；比较脚本成功计算预算余量。大堡口福三件套将可乐换为无糖可乐后重新核价为 ¥22.90。见[本次真实运行](examples/verified-run.md)。

上述真实运行属于初版单工具直连路径。此次升级新增批量入口、偏好数量检查、安装脚本和离线回归用例；新入口的验证状态单独记录在 [版本说明](CHANGELOG.md)，不扩大原有真实运行记录的范围。`demo-quotes.json` 始终是模拟数据。

比较只覆盖本轮候选；它不保证全菜单最低价。价格、券适用性和供应状态以麦当劳官方当前结果为准。营养、配料及过敏原未纳入本版推荐规则。

## 项目结构

```text
skills/mcd-budget-meal/
  SKILL.md                 对话流程、门店和候选选择
  scripts/mcp_query.py     官方 MCP查询客户端
  scripts/quote_meals.py   批量核价、请求绑定、自动比较
  scripts/compare_meals.py 预算与偏好检查、排序、Markdown输出
  references/             数据格式和兼容说明
examples/                 虚构示例与历史真实运行摘要
tests/                    纯离线回归用例，无Token、无网络
install.ps1               Windows用户级技能安装
```

离线回归命令为 `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`，检查金额、数量、排除项、过期报价、异常响应和失败停止行为。它使用合成响应，不代表真实 MCP 联调结果。

## 许可与声明

本项目原创 Skill、脚本和示例采用 [MIT License](LICENSE)。官方参赛声明保留原文，适用其原有声明和规则；本项目非麦当劳官方产品。使用 MCP 须遵守官方服务规则。

items.description: 雾帆 MistSail：基于 Sheas Cealer 1.1.4 的本地改版。一键在本机接管 TLS 握手（nginx 改写 SNI / 回环中继分片 ClientHello），无代理服务器。仅供抵御网络非法监听与网络安全研究。
items.readme:
雾帆 MistSail

— 让握手藏进雾里 —

基于开源项目 Sheas Cealer 1.1.4 的本地改版 · WPF / .NET 8 · Windows

## 这是什么 HTTPS 加密了网页内容，但 TLS 握手第一个数据包 ClientHello 里的 SNI 仍是明文，链路上的中间设备可以据此识别、劫持或重置连接。 雾帆在本机接管握手，不使用任何境外代理服务器、VPN 或 TUN： | 路线 | 适用 | 做法 | |---|---|---| | 本机 nginx 改写 SNI | 常规站点 | hosts 把域名指向 `127.0.0.1`，本机 nginx 用自签证书接管浏览器连接，再以改写后的 SNI 连向真实服务器 | | 回环中继分片 | 拒绝改写 SNI 的 Cloudflare 类站点 | hosts 把域名指向 `127.0.0.2`，进程内 `SniRelay` 把首个 ClientHello 按 TLS record 切片后透传，浏览器与真实服务器仍是端到端 TLS | 主界面只有一个电源按钮，旧功能收进「更多功能」；连通性卡片、线路探测与「复制诊断信息」用于排查。 ## 下载 到 [Releases](https://github.com/CuteEthanLeo/MistSail/releases) 下载 `MistSail-v*-win-x64.zip`，完整解压到新目录后右键 `MistSail.exe` 以管理员身份运行。压缩包为自包含 x64 版本，无需另装 .NET。 ## 关于根证书，请如实了解 - 全局模式启动时会生成一枚**自签根证书**并安装到**当前用户**的受信任根证书存储，仅用于让浏览器信任本机 nginx。 - 出站到真实服务器仍是正常 TLS。回环分片中继这条路线不经过 nginx，也不解密任何流量。 - 停止后证书会被清理；也可以随时在 `certmgr.msc` 里手动删除。 ## 构建 依赖：.NET 8 SDK、Windows 10 17763+。 1. 从官方 [Sheas Cealer 1.1.4](https://github.com/SpaceTimee/Sheas-Cealer/releases) 免安装压缩包解压到 `vendor/upstream-1.1.4/`（提供 `Cealing-Nginx.exe`、`Cealing-Mihomo.exe` 等二进制，本仓库不包含）。 2. `lib/` 内已附带官方发行包中的 `Sheas-Core.dll`、`Ona-Core.dll`，用于解决原始源码缺少两个兄弟项目导致无法构建的问题。 3. 运行： ```powershell .\Build-Package.ps1 ``` 脚本会先执行 `Verification/RelayCheck` 离线自检（只走回环地址，不访问外网），再发布自包含 x64 包到 `artifacts/`。 ## 配置 `direct-config.json` 集中了全部参数，常用项： | 键 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `FragmentMode` | `tls-record` | 分片方式；`tcp` 为 TCP 写入分片；`off` 关闭 | | `FragmentBytes` | 8 | 域名区域的分片字节数，域名总会被从中间切开 | | `FragmentDelayMs` | 8 | 片与片之间的发送间隔 | | `RelayListenAddress` | `127.0.0.2` | 分片中继监听的回环地址 | | `RelayHosts` | … | 走分片中继的域名与候选 IP | | `DohServers` | Cloudflare / Quad9 / Google | 加密 DNS，带引导 IP | 修改后停止并重新连接生效。更多说明见 [README_DIRECT.md](README_DIRECT.md) 与 [README_X_RELAY.md](README_X_RELAY.md)。 ## 日志与诊断 - `logs/relay.log`：分片中继的每条连接结果（目标 IP、握手阶段、错误形态），不记录 URL、Cookie 或请求头。 - `logs/direct.log`：实验性浏览器直连模式的日志。 - 主界面「复制诊断信息」会把连通性结果与线路对照结论一起复制到剪贴板。 ## 能力边界 加密 DNS 与握手处理只能改善 DNS 污染和部分握手识别导致的问题，**不改变路由，不能保证突破目标 IP 封锁、全部协议识别或站点自身的地区/账户限制**。这是客户端方案的边界。 ## 注意事项与免责声明 1. 本项目及所有相关资源仅供**抵御网络非法监听**和**开展网络安全研究**使用，无意绕过任何国家审查设备的审查。 2. 使用前请阅读上游项目的[隐私政策](https://thoughts.teambition.com/share/6264eda98adeb10041b92fda#title=Sheas_Cealer_隐私政策)与[使用协议](https://thoughts.teambition.com/share/6264edd78adeb10041b92fdb#title=Sheas_Cealer_使用协议)，并遵守所在地法律法规。 3. 本改版处于实验阶段，不保证任何站点可用；请勿与其他代理、VPN 或 TUN 软件同时使用。 ## 目录说明 | 路径 | 内容 | |---|---| | `Direct/` | 本改版新增：`SniRelay`、`FragmentingStream`、`DohResolver`、`DirectRelay`、`LineProbe` | | `Wins/` `Consts/` `Convs/` `Preses/` `Proces/` `Utils/` `Props/` | 上游 WPF 源码及本改版的界面修改 | | `Verification/RelayCheck/` | 离线自检程序 | | `vendor/Cealing-Host-U.json` | 上游规则快照（文本） | | `docs/upstream/` | 上游项目原始 README | | `docs/video/` | 项目介绍视频的离线渲染脚本（Pillow + numpy + ffmpeg） | ## 致谢 - **Space Time** 的 [Sheas Cealer](https://github.com/SpaceTimee/Sheas-Cealer)、[Cealing Host](https://github.com/SpaceTimee/Cealing-Host)：本项目的全部基础。 - **kit** 与 **NiceBowl**：SNI 伪造原理与[说明文章](https://nicebowl.fun/24_8)。 - upb-syssec 2023 年关于 TLS record 分片的公开测量。 ## 许可 上游仓库未附带 LICENSE 文件，上游代码版权归原作者所有。本仓库对上游的修改与新增代码（`Direct/`、界面与构建脚本）以与上游相同的条件提供；若上游作者另有要求，将随时调整。

items.readme:
# 通用后台管理脚手架

用于后续后台管理系统开发的 Spring Boot + Vue 底座。包含认证、菜单与按钮权限、数据权限、组织管理、字典、参数、日志、工作台和代码生成骨架；新增项目在此基础上实现业务模块。

## 开发入口

- [项目地图](PROJECT_MAP.md)：按功能定位页面、接口、服务、SQL 和权限。
- [设计规范](DESIGN.md)：珍珠玻璃主题、组件复用及交互规范。
- [开发约定](AGENTS.md)、[更新日志](changelog.md)。
- [后端架构](docs/backend-architecture.md)、[前后端接口约定](docs/frontend-backend-integration.md)、[前端架构](docs/admin-redesign-architecture.md)。

## 目录与技术栈

| 目录 | 用途 | 技术栈 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scaffold-system` | 后端 Maven 多模块工程 | Java 17+、Spring Boot 3.5、MyBatis、MySQL、Redis、JWT |
| `scaffold-vue` | 管理后台 | Vue 3、TypeScript、Vite 6、Vue Router 4、GSAP 3，自有组件库 |
| `scaffold-system/sql` | 首次初始化脚本 | `V1__init_schema.sql` 建表，`V2__seed_data.sql` 初始化数据 |
| `docs` | 当前架构说明 | 后端架构、前后端接口约定和前端组件架构 |

当前包含工作台和 10 个管理页面；建筑、工作流模块已移除。

## 本地启动

准备 JDK 17 或更新版本、Maven、Node.js 22+、MySQL 5.7+ 和 Redis；前后端依赖均使用项目现有配置。

后端读取进程环境变量，不会自动加载 `.env` 文件；可在 IDE 运行配置或启动终端中设置：

| 变量 | 中文说明 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `JWT_SECRET` | JWT 签名密钥，至少 32 字节且不能全为空白 | 必填，无默认值 |
| `DB_HOST` / `DB_PORT` | MySQL 地址 / 端口 | `localhost` / `3306` |
| `DB_NAME` | 数据库名称 | `scaffold_system` |
| `DB_USERNAME` / `DB_PASSWORD` | 数据库账号 / 密码 | 本地开发默认账号；按实际环境配置 |
| `DB_TIMEZONE` | 数据库连接与会话时区 | `+08:00` |
| `REDIS_HOST` / `REDIS_PORT` | Redis 地址 / 端口 | `localhost` / `6379` |
| `REDIS_PASSWORD` | Redis 密码 | 空；按实际环境配置 |
| `VITE_API_PROXY_TARGET` | 前端开发代理的后端地址 | `http://localhost:8080` |

可在启动后端的终端中生成本机密钥；生成结果保留在当前进程环境，不写入仓库：

```bash
export JWT_SECRET="$(openssl rand -hex 32)"
```

使用 IDE 时将密钥配置到运行环境。未配置或不足 32 字节时后端启动失败；保留同一密钥可让重启前的有效 token 继续验签，更换密钥会使旧 token 失效。

首次创建空的 `scaffold_system` 库后，按顺序导入两份 SQL；mysql 客户端须使用 `--default-character-set=utf8mb4`，并通过 `--init-command="SET time_zone='+08:00'"` 设置会话时区。也可在 IDE 运行 `scaffold-admin` 中的 `com.scaffold.admin.util.DbInit`，该工具使用同一组 `DB_*` 变量并按版本顺序初始化；参数 `fix` 会删除整个目标库，仅在核实库名、备份且明确同意重建时使用。

```bash
# 在 scaffold-system 目录构建与启动后端
mvn -pl scaffold-admin -am package -DskipTests
java -jar scaffold-admin/target/scaffold-admin-0.1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar
```

```bash
# 在 scaffold-vue 目录启动前端；首次使用先 npm ci
npm run dev
```

浏览器访问 `http://localhost:5173`，后端本地端口为 `8080`；前端统一通过 `/api` 代理访问后端。

种子库管理员为 `admin`，开发密码为 `admin123`；仅用于本地开发，接入实际环境前请修改密码并配置自己的数据库与 Redis 凭据。种子组织和用户为示例，电话留空，邮箱使用 `example.com`。验证码使用页面显示的字符。超级管理员可见全部启用且可见的已注册菜单，并拥有全部操作权限；其余种子角色默认未授予菜单，需在角色管理中分配。无可用菜单的账号登录后显示“暂未分配可用菜单”。

## 新业务模块

1. 先设计业务表与中文字段含义；默认包含 `create_by`、`update_by`、`create_time`、`update_time` 四个审计字段。
2. 复用 `scaffold-common` 的返回、分页与异常，以及 `scaffold-framework` 的权限、数据权限、操作日志能力。
3. 前端列表复用 `ListPage`、`useListPage` / `useTreeListPage`；表单复用 `FormDialog`、`Field` 和现有控件，操作复用 `PermissionButton`。
4. 在 `src/api` 接入统一 HTTP 客户端，在 `src/composables/auth.ts` 的 `COMPONENT_MAP` 注册页面，再添加菜单和按钮权限。
5. 按角色配置菜单和数据范围，验证低权限账号的真实接口拒绝行为、查询、分页、导出及表单校验。
6. 同步项目地图、相关接口说明和更新日志。

代码生成初始配置为空，按需导入当前数据库的真实表，支持字段信息查看、配置说明保存、7 个文件预览和 ZIP 下载。输出为开发骨架：Controller、Service、Mapper 的业务 CRUD 仍需实现，前端页面需按统一组件规范补齐；下载不会自动写入本工程。

## 验证

不连接数据库和 Redis 的测试与编译：

```bash
# 在 scaffold-system 目录
mvn -pl scaffold-framework -am test
mvn -pl scaffold-admin -am package -DskipTests
```

完整后端集成测试需要配置上述环境变量并准备独立校验库：

```bash
# 在 scaffold-system 目录；建议用独立校验库，测试会写入夹具和日志
mvn -pl scaffold-admin -am test
```

```bash
# 在 scaffold-vue 目录
npm run test:unit
npm run build
# 已安装 Python Playwright 与 Chromium 时，可验证真实浏览器会话与权限
python3 scripts/session-regression.py
```

浏览器回归脚本只创建并删除自己生成的测试角色和用户，不清空表；管理员密码可通过 `SCAFFOLD_TEST_PASSWORD` 覆盖。测试与构建成功不能代替业务页面验收。

items.name: ai-writer
items.description: ✨ Multilingual AI product copy from images. Responsive writing studio, translation, accounts, credits and automatic setup with optional Docker MySQL.
items.readme:
Turn product photos into clear, multilingual ecommerce copy.
Paste images. Choose a language. Make the draft your own.

Quick start · Features · Deployment · Türkçe

## What you can do - **Write from images:** generate descriptions from one to eight public HTTPS product photos. - **Fetch product photos:** collect image links from a public product page using Puppeteer. - **Write for your audience:** English, Turkish, Spanish, German, French and Chinese output. - **Edit, copy and translate:** refine the draft in the browser and translate it with one action. - **Manage accounts and credits:** bcrypt passwords, MySQL sessions, ten starter credits and refunds for failed generation requests. - **Explore video drafts:** extract up to eight frames from a short YouTube video. This integration is experimental and depends on upstream YouTube downloader availability. ![AI Writer image studio](docs/studio.png) AI Writer produces drafts. Verify product claims before publishing; an image cannot reliably establish fabric composition, measurements or certifications. The application prompts the model to avoid inventing such details. ## Quick start ### Requirements - Node.js **22.12 or later** and npm - Docker with Compose **or** an existing MySQL 8+ server - An OpenAI API key with access to a vision-capable Chat Completions model - Chrome installed by Puppeteer for page image fetching - FFmpeg and FFprobe on `PATH` for the experimental video feature ### Automatic setup ```bash git clone https://github.com/csadigital/ai-writer.git cd ai-writer npm run setup npm start ``` The installer downloads dependencies and Chrome, asks for your OpenAI key without echoing it, generates session/database secrets and initializes MySQL. Choose **docker** to start a persistent MySQL container automatically, or **existing** to use your own server. For an existing server it can create a dedicated database and app user with administrator credentials; the administrator password is never saved. Existing `.env` values are preserved and backed up locally. Open **http://localhost:3000** after setup. The installer requires an interactive terminal and Node.js 22.12+. Docker needs to be installed and running for the automatic server option. FFmpeg remains optional for video generation. To stop the local Docker database without deleting its data: ```bash docker compose -f compose.mysql.yml stop ``` Changing database credentials in `.env` does not reset an already initialized Docker volume. Keep the existing credentials or migrate the database deliberately. ### Manual setup ```bash git clone https://github.com/csadigital/ai-writer.git cd ai-writer npm ci cp .env.example .env node -e "console.log(require('node:crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('hex'))" ``` Paste the generated random value into `SESSION_SECRET` in `.env`, then configure your OpenAI key and MySQL connection. Use fresh credentials; never commit `.env`. Create the database and user with your MySQL administrator, grant the app user access to that database, then initialize its tables: ```bash mysql -h 127.0.0.1 -u ai_writer -p ai_writer < schema.sql npm start ``` Open **http://localhost:3000**, create an account and sign in. New accounts receive ten credits. Successful description generation or translation costs one credit. The application does not include payments or automated credit purchases. ### Environment | Variable | Purpose | Default | | --- | --- | --- | | `OPENAI_API_KEY` | OpenAI API credential | Required | | `OPENAI_MODEL` | Vision-capable Chat Completions model | `gpt-4.1-mini` | | `SESSION_SECRET` | Random secret, at least 32 characters | Required | | `DB_HOST` / `DB_PORT` | MySQL server | `127.0.0.1` / `3306` | | `DB_USER` / `DB_PASSWORD` | MySQL credentials | Configure locally | | `DB_NAME` | Application database | `ai_writer` | | `PORT` | HTTP server port | `3000` | | `NODE_ENV` | Runtime mode | `development` | | `TRUST_PROXY` | Trust one HTTPS reverse proxy | `0` | The model can be configured for your account. Image requests follow the [official OpenAI image-input documentation](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/images-vision); local video frames are sent as data URLs rather than inaccessible localhost links. ## Development ```bash npm run dev npm run check npm test npm audit --omit=dev ``` Tests cover authentication, session rotation, CSRF checks, URL validation, escaped output, image generation, translation, credit refunds and parallel spending. Local application tests isolate database and AI services. CI also provisions a real, temporary MySQL server to verify the automatic installer schema and database user grants. Tests do not use production credentials or make paid API calls. ```text app.js Express application, account and credit routes db.js MySQL pool youtube.js Experimental bounded video workflow lib/ai.js Model requests and multilingual prompts lib/network.js Public HTTPS URL validation views/ EJS pages and shared layout public/ Styles, browser code and branding schema.sql Account table scripts/setup.js Interactive automatic installer compose.mysql.yml Optional local MySQL server test/ Automated regression checks ``` ## Deployment and limitations Read [the deployment guide](docs/DEPLOYMENT.md) before exposing the application to the internet. HTTPS, restricted network egress and a sandboxed browser are required for a public server. DNS validation alone is not a complete defense against DNS rebinding. The credit balance prevents overspending, but this project has no billing integration, password recovery or email verification. YouTube may reject automated downloads. Videos must be non-live, no longer than three minutes and no larger than 50 MB. Failed processing returns its reserved credit. Use only media you are authorized to process. Publishing this repository makes the source code public; it does not provision a hosted application or a live demo. ## Contributing See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). For sensitive reports, use the process in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). ## License [ISC](LICENSE).
